entry.title: Moonshot AI's PerceptionBench Reveals No Frontier Model Sees Past 60%
entry.summary: Moonshot AI's PerceptionBench reveals no frontier model clears 60% accuracy on pure visual perception tasks, exposing a critical gap in how we evaluate multimodal AI.

entry.title: Goodfire's Silico Finds Human Cognitive Biases Geometrically Encoded Inside LLMs
entry.summary: Goodfire used mechanistic interpretability to find a 'bouba-kiki space' inside Llama and Gemma, and is opening access to Silico, the platform that found it.
